subject: Onsite workshop: overnight connection oversell — recovery & itinerary stitching
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@stellatech.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: StellaTech Ops <ops@stellatech.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Workshop travel — overnight connection issue for two delegates

Hi Evelyn,

Quick heads-up: the airline just informed us two of our delegates (PNR ending 9KZ) were bumped due to an equipment swap and the late-night connection sold out. That affects the 22:45 leg arriving 00:30.

Options from our side:
- Confirm standby on the 01:15 red-eye (2 seats open but not confirmed).
- Rebook via a morning redeye with a 06:40 arrival and provide shuttle — adds 6 hours on-site wait.
- Move two delegates to Samir's group (Novum) on a different itinerary arriving 23:50 (requires consent).

Can Redwood help stitch seats or authorize an overnight hotel + ground for the two? We can reimburse lodging if needed. Attaching the updated attendee PNRs and the draft agenda.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Morales
Events & Ops, StellaTech
elena@stellatech.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: PNR_changes.csv, agenda_v2.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@stellatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Workshop travel — overnight connection issue for two delegates

Thanks for the flag, Elena. I see the PNRs — frustrating timing. Short answers below and a proposed immediate plan: 

Immediate plan (we can action within 2 hours):
1) Place both attendees on confirmed standby for the 01:15 red-eye; ask the airline for complimentary hotel if they clear late (low probability).
2) If standby doesn't clear by 20:00 PT tomorrow, book the 06:40 arrival seats and arrange hotel and morning transfer at Redwood expense (we'll invoice StellaTech after).
3) Offer the Novum transfer only with written consent from the delegates and a written agreement for seat/expense split.

I will coordinate with Marissa (travel desk) to hold cards and Connor (on-site logistics) to update shuttle windows. Can you confirm the two affected names and mobile numbers so we can enroll them on standby lists?

Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Events, Redwood Inference
evelyn@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@stellatech.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Workshop travel — overnight connection issue for two delegates

On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 9:45 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com> wrote:
> I will coordinate with Marissa (travel desk) to hold cards and Connor (on-site logistics) to update shuttle windows. Can you confirm the two affected names and mobile numbers so we can enroll them on standby lists?

Evelyn / Elena — got it. I put a soft hold on two 06:40 seats (will confirm with airline) and opened hotel inventory for one night at The Harbor Inn (corporate rate).

Please provide the two delegates' names and phones. If standby clears, I'll cancel the morning booking before it's ticketed. If not, I will ticket the morning legs and send the e-receipts to ops@stellatech.com.

Ben — please loop finance for whether we should bill StellaTech or take the hotel cost against the workshop contingency.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Global Travel Coordinator, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0222

From: Elena Morales <elena@stellatech.com>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 19:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Workshop travel — overnight connection issue for two delegates

Hi team — quick update after touching base with the two delegates (Prasad K. and Mira S.):
- They prefer not to swap groups with Novum.
- Standby did not clear for 01:15.
- We're OK with the morning redeye (06:40) plus hotel for the night — appreciate Redwood covering the room.

Connor: please shift the shuttle pick-up to 07:15 for two extra passengers (pick-up at Terminal 2 curbside). Marissa: please ticket the morning legs and send PNR/e-receipts. Ben / Evelyn: please confirm whether Redwood will invoice StellaTech for the hotel or absorb under event contingency.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. See you all at the workshop.

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Morales
Events & Ops, StellaTech
